name: Waranyu Bancherdvanich
summary: Master of Information Systems and Technology student at Curtin University, specialising in data analytics and visualisation, with a bachelor’s degree in statistics and finance. I build Power BI dashboards on data I have audited and modelled myself, and I forecast in R so the method can be checked. Most recently I led the financial analysis for a Curtin Consulting Group engagement with Hockey WA. Four portfolio projects run on their real data at waranyu-cv.vercel.app. Seeking a data analyst internship in Perth, and graduate roles from July 2027.

entries.title: Master of Information Systems and Technology

sections.title: Key Skills
skills: Skilled in using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Python, and R to clean, analyse, and present data insights through dashboards and reports.
Knowledge of SQL, ERD design, dimensional modelling, star schema design, and database structure.
Experienced in linear regression, time-series analysis, forecasting and prediction intervals in R, and in break-even, scenario and sensitivity modelling in Excel.
Able to explain data findings clearly through dashboards, reports, and presentations.

entries.title: Student Consultant (Finance Lead)
entries.org: Curtin Consulting Group – Client: Hockey WA
bullets: Led the financial analysis in a 9-person team developing Hockey WA’s broadcast streaming strategy.
Built a 20-year Excel break-even model across 3 scenarios, giving the board a payback range to decide on, in place of a provider arrangement that returned no revenue.
Tested 5 drivers at ±20%: audience growth moved payback 7× more than build cost, refocusing the recommendation on marketing over upfront funding.
Benchmarked assumptions against 15+ case studies, so every forecast could be traced to a public source.
Created an 18-camera 3D venue render and a 3-view streaming prototype, turning the plan into something the client and panel could see and use.

entries.title: Digital Marketing & Data Analytics Intern
entries.org: Like Me Co., Ltd. – Bangkok, Thailand
bullets: Supported digital marketing campaigns through social media content, product research, and competitor analysis.
Conducted basic data tracking and market research to support campaign planning and business decisions.
Assisted with content writing and customer trend analysis to improve marketing communication.

entries.title: MGMT6052 Consultancy Project (Capstone)
entries.org: Quality and Documentation Manager – Client: LocoLabo, Curtin Business School
bullets: Tested the base AI model across 15 business areas and identified Australian privacy law as its weakest, giving the client clear evidence to approve the project focus.
Trained a privacy-law expert adapter that reached 81% accuracy on a sealed 170-question test, using only free tools, proving the client’s “small model, plug-in expert” idea works.
Found a one-line training setting that more than doubled accuracy (38% to 81%), now the core of the recipe recommended to the client.
Delivered a 6-step handover recipe and client presentation, so the next team can build an adapter for a new subject much faster.

entries.title: FreshMart Sales Performance Dashboard
entries.org: Power BI, Power Query, DAX, Kimball Star Schema
bullets: Audited 5 raw operational files in Power Query and remapped 93 orphaned sales rows instead of dropping them, keeping revenue totals accurate and the data gap visible.
Modelled 17,697 transactions across 12 stores into a Kimball star schema, so managers can see which regions and categories drive profit without stitching spreadsheets together.
Built DAX measures for revenue, gross margin and year-on-year time intelligence, so growth is judged against a fair like-for-like comparison rather than a raw total.

entries.title: Renewable Electricity Transition Dashboard
entries.org: Power BI, Power Query, DAX, R, Linear Regression, Policy Analysis
bullets: Reconciled data from national energy agencies into a Power BI galaxy schema, showing Australia’s renewable share rising from 9% to 35%, benchmarked against Germany, New Zealand and China.
Linked the trend to policy: share stalled while the Renewable Energy Target was under review, then grew nearly 5× faster after the 2015 target reset.
Forecast with R linear regression that Australia reaches only 37.8% renewable share by 2030 against the 82% target, so the target is unlikely on the current trend.

entries.title: Football Club Database Design and SQL Implementation
entries.org: Group project (3) – Oracle SQL, ERD, Normalisation
bullets: Translated 18 business rules into an ERD and a normalised 16-table Oracle schema, so questions like the season ladder are answered without duplicated data.
Wrote 9 analytical SQL queries using joins, subqueries and HAVING, answering real organiser questions such as the ladder, top scorers and goals per ground.
Used a LEFT JOIN to keep goalless games in the averages, avoiding the inflated goals-per-ground figures an inner join would have produced.
Created a data dictionary and inserted a full sample season of 56 games and 154 goals, so the schema is documented for others and every query is tested on realistic data.

Managed multiple tasks under pressure while maintaining accuracy with orders, payments, and customer requests.
